1.web: After this Job opened his mouth, and cursed the day of his birth.
1.asv: After this opened Job his mouth, and cursed his day.

3.web: “Let the day perish in which I was born, the night which said, ‘There is a boy conceived.’
3.asv: Let the day perish wherein I was born, And the night which said, There is a man-child conceived.

4.web: Let that day be darkness. Don’t let God from above seek for it, neither let the light shine on it.
4.asv: Let that day be darkness; Let not God from above seek for it, Neither let the light shine upon it.

5.web: Let darkness and the shadow of death claim it for their own. Let a cloud dwell on it. Let all that makes black the day terrify it.
5.asv: Let darkness and the shadow of death claim it for their own; Let a cloud dwell upon it; Let all that maketh black the day terrify it.

6.web: As for that night, let thick darkness seize on it. Let it not rejoice among the days of the year. Let it not come into the number of the months.
6.asv: As for that night, let thick darkness seize upon it: Let it not rejoice among the days of the year; Let it not come into the number of the months.

7.web: Behold, let that night be barren. Let no joyful voice come therein.
7.asv: Lo, let that night be barren; Let no joyful voice come therein.

8.web: Let them curse it who curse the day, who are ready to rouse up leviathan.
8.asv: Let them curse it that curse the day, Who are ready to rouse up leviathan.

9.web: Let the stars of its twilight be dark. Let it look for light, but have none, neither let it see the eyelids of the morning,
9.asv: Let the stars of the twilight thereof be dark: Let it look for light, but have none; Neither let it behold the eyelids of the morning:

10.web: because it didn’t shut up the doors of my mother’s womb, nor did it hide trouble from my eyes.
10.asv: Because it shut not up the doors of mymother’swomb, Nor hid trouble from mine eyes.

11.web: “Why didn’t I die from the womb? Why didn’t I give up the spirit when my mother bore me?
11.asv: Why died I not from the womb? Why did I not give up the ghost when my mother bare me?

12.web: Why did the knees receive me? Or why the breast, that I should nurse?
12.asv: Why did the knees receive me? Or why the breasts, that I should suck?

13.web: For now should I have lain down and been quiet. I should have slept, then I would have been at rest,
13.asv: For now should I have lain down and been quiet; I should have slept; then had I been at rest,

14.web: with kings and counselors of the earth, who built up waste places for themselves;
14.asv: With kings and counsellors of the earth, Who built up waste places for themselves;

15.web: or with princes who had gold, who filled their houses with silver:
15.asv: Or with princes that had gold, Who filled their houses with silver:

16.web: or as a hidden untimely birth I had not been, as infants who never saw light.
16.asv: Or as a hidden untimely birth I had not been, As infants that never saw light.

17.web: There the wicked cease from troubling. There the weary are at rest.
17.asv: There the wicked cease from troubling; And there the weary are at rest.

18.web: There the prisoners are at ease together. They don’t hear the voice of the taskmaster.
18.asv: There the prisoners are at ease together; They hear not the voice of the taskmaster.

19.web: The small and the great are there. The servant is free from his master.
19.asv: The small and the great are there: And the servant is free from his master.

20.web: “Why is light given to him who is in misery, life to the bitter in soul,
20.asv: Wherefore is light given to him that is in misery, And life unto the bitter in soul;

21.web: Who long for death, but it doesn’t come; and dig for it more than for hidden treasures,
21.asv: Who long for death, but it cometh not, And dig for it more than for hid treasures;

22.web: who rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave?
22.asv: Who rejoice exceedingly, And are glad, when they can find the grave?

23.web: Why is light given to a man whose way is hidden, whom God has hedged in?
23.asv: Why is light givento a man whose way is hid, And whom God hath hedged in?

24.web: For my sighing comes before I eat. My groanings are poured out like water.
24.asv: For my sighing cometh before I eat, And my groanings are poured out like water.

25.web: For the thing which I fear comes on me, That which I am afraid of comes to me.
25.asv: For the thing which I fear cometh upon me, And that which I am afraid of cometh unto me.

26.web: I am not at ease, neither am I quiet, neither have I rest; but trouble comes.”
26.asv: I am not at ease, neither am I quiet, neither have I rest; But trouble cometh.
